test_title: PYST 37: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 30th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven friends, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are sitting in a straight line, all facing towards the north. N is sitting at the middle position. M is sitting between Q and P. Q is sitting to the immediate left of N. S is sitting to the immediate left of O. M and O are not sitting at any of the ends. Who is sitting at the right end?
solution:
Seven friends, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S, are sitting in a straight line, all facing towards the north.

1) N is sitting at the middle position and Q is sitting to the immediate left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2283d9cd416b5f73a158b06f9a73f89a349d96523467fee1ffbc81716213432.png] 

2) M is sitting between Q and P.&
